header: Cable renewal progress in each district
lead: The programme replaces 640 km of paper-insulated cable laid between 1958 and 1974. Each district has its own contractor and ground conditions, so each is counted separately.
note: Share of planned cable kilometres laid, as reported by the site managers at the end of December 2026. Not checked independently.

metrics.title: Ashcombe
metrics.text: 134 of 146 km. The last section, under the market square, is planned for the spring closure.

metrics.title: Marrowfield
metrics.text: 79 of 129 km. Rock under the eastern industrial estate has slowed the work.

metrics.title: Old Harbour
metrics.text: 31 of 113 km. Work started last because the harbour works had to finish first.
